summary: Where is an upright index finger wagging side to side, with lowered eyebrows. It goes at the end of the question: BATHROOM WHERE.
steps: Hold your index finger up, palm facing out.
Wag it side to side two or three times, like 'no-no' but with the palm out.
Eyebrows down. Put it at the end: YOU LIVE WHERE.
mistakes: Wagging the whole arm. Only the finger moves, from the wrist.
Confusing it with NO. WHERE is one finger wagging; NO is two fingers snapping to the thumb.
